product_one_liner.value: Aviatrix provides enterprise cloud networking and runtime security that lets security, cloud, and networking teams govern and contain workload communications across multicloud environments.

eng_blog.notes: Technical posts explain Kubernetes Firewall architecture and CRD integration (Anirban Sengupta, CTO) and the Google Cloud Network Connectivity Center integration architecture (Rizwan Jamal, network architect/design engineer).

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live company board lists Sr.MTS - Software Development (Cloud AI Network Security Developer); older investor-board mirrors mark a matching role closed, so current company-board presence is the basis for this answer.

model_provider.notes: The assessment application explicitly uses OpenRouter to access multiple AI models; the Secure Network Supervisor Agent integrates Microsoft Security Copilot. Specific underlying model names are not disclosed in these sources.

compliance_certs.notes: Public Trust Center claims; GDPR denotes its listed compliance claim rather than a formal GDPR certification standard.

last_funding.notes: Latest recorded financing is December 8, 2022; amount is undisclosed and omitted. The last publicly announced priced round was the $200 million Series E in September 2021, not the latest recorded transaction.

raised_18mo.notes: Latest recorded financing, December 2022, precedes the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Strategic Account Executive - United States is listed on the live board.

launched_6mo.notes: Aviatrix announced Clearance on October 26, 2026, within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Scott Leatherman’s profile dates his Aviatrix Chief Marketing Officer tenure through January 2026, establishing a departure within November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Aviatrix’s enterprise applications developer posting names Salesforce/CPQ and integrations with Salesloft, Marketo and Clari; the posting is archived, so this is a stack signal rather than proof of current deployment.
